items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...what did Julie Andrews say in The Sound of Music? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Well, my full name now is Yusef Abdul Lateef...

ctx.x: Thank you. Uh, why don’t we start with uh–what did Julie Andrews say in The Sound of Music? I shouldn’t do this, should I?–the beginning, a very good place to start. Just some personal information: you’re full name, date and place of birth?
Well, my full name now is Yusef Abdul Lateef; however, I was born uh my name was William Emanuel Huddleston. I was born October 9, 1920 in Chattanooga, Tennessee.
